facts.text: Tarzan, bananas, now. And the new guy keeps talking. Tell Jane the bananas are mine, and so is that tree.
facts.why: Terk never says this and no 'new guy' is in the film. Her real lines on the quote page include 'Best friend coming through. That would be me.'
facts.fix: Out of my road! Best friend coming through. That would be me.

fix_note.text: Out of my road! Best friend coming through. That would be me.

facts.text: Tarzan's treehouse built from the camp supplies
facts.why: The treehouse is built by Tarzan's shipwrecked parents from parts salvaged from their wreck, not from the explorers' camp supplies.
facts.fix: Tarzan's treehouse, built by his shipwrecked parents
facts.applied_note: Shorter, to stay within the length of the old line.

facts.text: Serve the tea when Jane sets out her tea service in the jungle.
facts.why: No transcript, quote page or plot shows Jane setting out a tea service. What is shown is the gorillas wrecking her camp.
facts.fix: Serve the tea when the gorillas wreck Jane's camp.

facts.text: the proper English tea Jane brings to the jungle
facts.why: No source shows Jane serving tea in the jungle, only the gorillas wrecking her camp.
facts.fix: proper English tea, for Jane's camp in the jungle

facts.text: Caught off the waterfall below the treehouse
facts.why: The Wikiquote scene notes show Tarzan scaling a waterfall on his own as a young man, but nothing places a waterfall below the treehouse.
facts.fix: Caught below the waterfall Tarzan climbs
